agent.result_text:
I added the overdue-total to the rollup audit lines, and all 4 Playwright tests pass (`bin/e2e`).

The change is server-side only, in `src/main/java/net/officefloor/hq/app/rollup/`:

- **`Rollup.java`**: each person's overdue-total is now worked out the same way the screen does it. It adds up their counting claims that are OPEN or PENDING and past their due-by on the sheet's today, late charge included. A claim with no figure (n/a) adds nothing, and the total isn't capped. The sheet's overdue-total is everyone's added together.
  - **ROLLUP lines**: one is now written when a person's claimed, due-total or overdue-total moves, and the line ends with `overdue-total=<x>`.
  - **TOTALS lines**: one is now written when any of the three totals moves, and the line ends with `overdue-total=<total>`.
- **`Figures.java` and `RollupSnapshot.java`**: these now also hold the overdue-total, so a change can compare the before and after values.

The change of the sheet's today already took a snapshot before and after, so moving today now writes ROLLUP and TOTALS lines when it puts a claim past its due-by or takes one out of overdue, even if no due figure moved. All the other actions that already write rollup lines pick this up the same way.
